title: Stage 1 Mixture-of-Experts Adversarial Assessment: Ask Pipeline Fault Tolerance, Simulator State Isolation & Quick-Win Fixes

findings.title: JSON.parse('{"__proto__":true}') on localStorage 'yt_compact_options_expanded' could introduce prototype-key pollution if unguarded
findings.resolution: Hardened normalizeCompactOptionsMap() in src/utils/userscript-helpers.ts to explicitly drop '__proto__', 'constructor', and 'prototype' keys before constructing state object; verified in unit test #23.

findings.title: Simultaneous per-window ttsToastTimersRef timers could fire stale updates after individual window closeWindow(id) or component unmount
findings.resolution: closeWindow(id) clears the exact videoId entry in ttsToastTimersRef.current and deletes ttsToasts[id], while useEffect cleanup clears all active timer handles on unmount.

findings.title: Simulator Fault Injection wrapper in test_ask_and_images.js Case 13 & Case 14 mutates window.GM_xmlhttpRequest
findings.resolution: Both Case 13 and Case 14 immediately restore original window.GM_xmlhttpRequest after job resolution so downstream suites execute cleanly against default shim behavior.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 2 Trusted Types CSP zero-innerHTML gate (AUD-03), bounded LRU storage eviction (AUD-01), and Stage 3 non-blocking Shadow DOM toasts + resize-listener cleanup remain properly sequenced next priorities.

findings.title: AUD-05: Offline/empty-transcript fallback in generateAlternativeTitle() returned and cached raw clickbait originalTitle when cleanLines.length === 0
findings.resolution: Tracked generatedFromContent flag and removed originalTitle self-fallback in generateAlternativeTitle(); added pure shouldCacheGeneratedAltTitle() helper (unit test #22) and Playwright Check 42f confirming alt_title:<videoId> stays null.

findings.title: AUD-07: Global 1s monitor setInterval wrote win.commit(true) every 1000ms instead of CONFIG.heartbeatMs (5000ms), amplifying GM storage writes 5x
findings.resolution: Gated active-job heartbeat commit inside the 1s monitor loop on now - (win._lastHbWriteTs || 0) >= CONFIG.heartbeatMs (5000ms production / 300ms fast test harness), preserving cross-tab staleness checks cleanly.

findings.title: Ask pipeline multi-hop fallback (Ask -> Pro 429 -> Flash) and full ladder exhaustion lacked automated E2E fault-injection coverage
findings.resolution: Added Case 13 (Ask fail + simulated Pro 429 -> gemini-3.8-flash completion with both diagnostic notes) and Case 14 (full 429 ladder exhaustion -> clean status === 'error', busy === false) in test_ask_and_images.js (Suite 4: 41/41 passing).

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 2 feed MutationObserver characterData noise filtering (AUD-02) and /shorts/<id> + recycled card dataset.ytaisVideoId tracking (AUD-04) cleanly target remaining scalability bottlenecks.

roleReviews.roleTitle: UX, Visual Layout & Spec Compliance Critic

findings.title: Single global ttsToast in App.tsx bled toast notifications across unrelated open floating windows during multi-window usage
findings.resolution: Replaced single toast state with per-window ttsToasts[videoId] map and scoped rendering ([data-toast-video-id={videoId}]); verified in live Chromium r3-stage1-toasts.png showing toast strictly in Window 2 (0 in Window 1).

findings.title: Compact window 'Options' disclosure toggle reset on page reload
findings.resolution: Persisted compactOptionsExpanded under localStorage 'yt_compact_options_expanded' validated by normalizeCompactOptionsMap(); verified Options ▴ remains expanded after reload in r3-stage1-compact-persist.png with 0 console errors/warnings.

roadmapReview.notes: Stage 3 accessibility (north/corner resize handles, keyboard arrow window ergonomics, ARIA live regions) and Stage 4 timestamp jump-sync + channel allow/exempt lists follow cleanly once Stage 2 DOM/storage hardening completes.
